title: Medal of Honor: Vanguard
shortDescription: Medal of Honor: Vanguard is organized in GameAtlas's Wii shooter collection with a source-linked record and deterministic catalog context.
highlights: Places a source-linked shooter entry in the Wii browsing path.
Retains source provenance while keeping the catalog context method-generated.
